svg.title: Three conical ends, connected through a core with handles
svg.desc: Original connected topology model and cutaway, with genus 3 and three ends. Two reflection-slice diagrams explain type 1 and type 2. These are illustrations of topology, not computed self-expanders; the cone is chosen for display.

g.text: One fixed cone; many possible genera
Hoffman–Martín–White · three-ended surfaces in ℝ³ · topology model
Shown: k = 4, a = 0, model genus 3. These small counts carry no existence claim.
All three wrap around the z-axis.
The reflection slice distinguishes two types
area test, not zoom or scale.
Theorem: g = pᵃk − 1, with p odd prime, a ≥ 0 and one suitable cone held fixed.
SCHEMATIC · no expander PDE is solved · ends and cut edges are truncated for display
Source: arXiv:2605.09657v1, Definitions 3.1 and 4.1, Figure 1, Theorems 1.2 and 5.1.
